channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Shelvin Mack | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Shelvin Mack from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Garrett Temple, Shelvin Mack, Kyle Anderson
item.description:
JB Bickerstaff:

“We’re going to be a completely different team than you guys saw at the end of last season. Our front office and ownership group have done a great job bringing in different players with different skill sets that kind of fit the theme and the direction that we’re heading in. We’re not as young as we used to be. We’ve brought in some proven, veteran guys like Kyle Anderson, Garrett Temple, Shelvin Mack, those type of guys, who can accentuate what Marc can do.”

JB Bickerstaff on Garrett Temple, Shelvin Mack, Kyle Anderson, Sep 12, 2018. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Shelvin Mack
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Quin Snyder:

“[Shelvin] has played in as many playoff games as the rest of our team combined. That experience factor plays in.”

Quin Snyder on Shelvin Mack, Feb 23, 2016. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward, Shelvin Mack
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Brad Stevens on Shelvin Mack + Gordon Hayward chemistry at Butler:

“Pretty good. Pretty good. I like that team. Pretty fun team to coach.”

Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward, Shelvin Mack, Feb 19, 2016. Source: Twitter @ESPNForsberg.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Shelvin Mack, Quin Snyder
item.description:
Jody Genessy:Jazz GM Dennis Lindsey:

“We have very good corporate knowledge of Shelvin (Mack). Quin (Snyder) was a big proponent of this acquisition.”

Dennis Lindsey on Shelvin Mack, Quin Snyder, Feb 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @DJJazzyJody.

item.title: Randy Wittman on Brian Cook, Shelvin Mack
item.description:
Wittman said of Barron and Pargo.

“It was tough, now. But this is the group that I believe in, and we’re moving forward with. It wasn’t easy. Obviously, injuries change a little bit, our thinking, as we moved forward. That’s the thing about this business. You never know. As I talked most of this preseason, guys had opportunities and took advantage of them. And they are here. “You never know what’s going to happen moving forward with both those guys – Cook and Shelvin – that were with me before, and it’s hard,”

Randy Wittman on Brian Cook, Shelvin Mack, Oct 31, 2012. Source: Washington Post.
